name: cowork-tools
description: Claude Cowork plugins by marcusk639: deep, fact-checked research (deep-research) and prompt engineering for Claude (prompt-engineer, prompt-engineer-advanced).

plugins.name: deep-research
plugins.description: Deep, multi-source, fact-checked research for Claude Cowork — fan-out web search, fetch, adversarial red-team verification, and fully cited synthesis using the Firecrawl/Exa connectors when enabled, with Cowork's built-in web tools as a no-setup fallback. Slash commands: /deep-research plus quick/standard/deep/ultradeep mode aliases.

plugins.name: prompt-engineer
plugins.description: Write, improve and debug prompts for Claude using Anthropic's prompt-engineering best practices (clarity, XML structure, chain of thought, multishot, chaining, hallucination reduction, consistency, jailbreak mitigation). No setup.

plugins.name: prompt-engineer-advanced
plugins.description: Design, optimize and evaluate prompts for LLMs: patterns, A/B testing, evaluation frameworks and test suites, structured outputs, system prompts with guardrails, context management. From Jeffallan/claude-skills (MIT). No setup.
